_about: Decision rules of repository onboarding (openspec/changes/repository-coach): a signal in the profile → components, each with the evidence that justified it. `when` is a condition over the profile (`path` is a dotted path; `fn` a named helper in rules.ts). `{name}` in a Hebrew text is filled from the context rules.ts computes; a param `{"$ctx": "name"}` takes the raw value. A component with its own `when` is part of the answer only when that holds too. A rule that relies on a fact the person marked wrong does not fire. Data, not code: a new rule is a row here.
